setup_command:
set -eu
rm -rf n8n-internship-repo
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/khosroghorbani/n8n-internship-repo.git
cd n8n-internship-repo
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi
run_command:
set -eu
cd n8n-internship-repo
printf '%s\n' '--- git ---'
git status --short --branch
git log -1 --oneline
printf '%s\n' '--- summary tree ---'
find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \
  -not -path './.git/*' \
  -not -path './node_modules/*' \
  -not -path './dist/*' \
  -not -path './build/*' \
  -not -path './.next/*' | sort | sed -n '1,250p'
printf '%s\n' '--- configuration files ---'
find . -maxdepth 4 -type f \( \
  -name 'README*' -o -name 'package.json' -o -name 'package-lock.json' -o -name 'pnpm-lock.yaml' -o -name 'yarn.lock' -o \
  -name 'tsconfig*.json' -o -name 'next.config.*' -o -name 'vite.config.*' -o -name 'Dockerfile*' -o \
  -name 'docker-compose*' -o -name '.env.example' -o -path './.github/workflows/*' \
  \) -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './node_modules/*' | sort
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  printf '%s\n' '--- package metadata and scripts ---'
  node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({name:p.name,version:p.version,private:p.private,scripts:p.scripts,dependencies:p.dependencies,devDependencies:p.devDependencies},null,2))"
  npm run lint --if-present
  npm run build --if-present
fi
test_command:
set -eu
cd n8n-internship-repo
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  npm test --if-present
elif find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name 'pytest.ini' -o -name 'pyproject.toml' -o -name 'setup.cfg' -o -name 'test_*.py' -o -path '*/tests/*.py' \) | grep -q .; then
  python -m pytest
else
  echo 'No recognized automated test configuration was found; test status requires manual verification.'
fi
